title: Measured child centers with and without retained feedback
description: Matched original BSZ2 and translated BSMZ1 finite-time scans, displayed relative to their own centers.
alt_text: Two gray parameter maps share a contraction scale. At zero retained feedback the dark tracks remain separated. At beta 0.006448531 the translated center shows an X-like dark junction. This measured visual pattern is distinct from the independently continued pair-trace contours.

root_evidence.replay_normalization: Euclidean state difference divided by max(1, norm of first saved orbit state)
root_evidence.scope: Saved root-state replay only; scan pixels do not inherit its orbit or exact-root status.

provenance.copy: Byte-identical copy of the audited compact publication PDF.

plot.coordinate_display: offsets from each window center, multiplied by 1e6

color_scale.scale_reference: union of original HR10 and complete BSZ1 cells
color_scale.gray_definition: all cells outside exponent > 0.001 AND period == 0; not all gray cells are verified periodic

sampled_recurrence.scope: Independently read both scan arrays and JSON summaries; these are recurrence candidates, not full-state orbit certificates.

visual_review.method: Rendered the actual compact publication PDF with Poppler at 130 dpi and inspected the resulting pixels.
visual_review.result: Both panels, axes, beta labels and shared gray scale are legible and unclipped; the translated image shows an X-like junction.
visual_review.immutable_audit_status: The source audit retains its original pending field; this separate review records subsequent visual inspection.

limits: Finite-horizon fixed-start measurements; period labels are recurrence candidates, not verified primitive orbits.
Every pixel is measured. No fitted crossing or interpolated saddle field replaces data.
The right panel is at a residual-qualified trace-root estimate, not an exact certified crossing.
Trace-zero contours, exact contraction ridges and finite-time image tracks are distinct.
The original panel is centered on the saved anchor; the translated panel uses the continued candidate.
Even endpoint grids omit the exact window centers; the candidate is not an actual measured pixel.
Fixed-opener recurrence does not certify orbit identity with the separately continued root orbit.
Root-state replay is independent of scan recurrence candidates; no full orbit was retained for every pixel.
